a.text: Hi, I'll stick to our agreement and operate in round 1. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, we may not reach 8 before a storm. If you want to propose a change to the plan, say so openly and we can agree on it together. Neither of us should take early without agreeing first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Two rounds of operating gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.
